description: This file defines the CalendarAccountACLService class, which manages access control logic for CalendarAccount objects based on user roles, account types, and actions performed.

classes.name: CalendarAccountACLService
classes.description: A service class for determining access permissions related to CalendarAccount objects, factoring in user roles, account types, and actions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the service with a CalendarAccount and a User.

methods.name: hasAccess
methods.description: Main method to determine if a user has access to perform a given action/view on the CalendarAccount.

methods.name: isNotAllowedAction
methods.description: Checks if the requested action/view is explicitly disallowed.

methods.name: isAllUsersAllowedAction
methods.description: Checks if the action/view is permitted for all users.

methods.name: isAdminAllowedAction
methods.description: Checks if the action/view is allowed for admin users.

methods.name: isOwnerAllowedAction
methods.description: Checks if the action/view is permitted for owners of the account.

methods.name: isSecurityGroupBasedAction
methods.description: Checks if the action/view is based on security group permissions.

methods.name: simplifyAction
methods.description: Normalizes the action/view name to a simplified form for permission checks.

methods.name: logAccessDenied
methods.description: Logs an access denied event when a user attempts an unauthorized action.
